mentions.name: Cadenya
mentions.description: This is an agent runtime that connects to an existing API or MCP, letting users link a conversation UI directly to their API without the usual agent plumbing.
mentions.problem: All of the plumbing required to build agents was overwhelming just to reach a hello-world state.
mentions.audience: The intended users are people building agents who want to hook a conversation UI up to their existing API or MCP.
mentions.source_excerpt:
An agent runtime that connects to your existing API or MCP: 
https://cadenya.com
mentions.author: btables
